site.title: Dylan Sohet — Full Stack Developer
site.description: Portfolio of Dylan Sohet, Full Stack Developer based in Saguenay, QC.

hero.tagline: I turn complex engineering challenges into simple, reliable software.

about.heading: About
about.p1: A motivated and curious Full Stack developer, always looking for new technologies to learn and challenges to take on. I specialize in TypeScript, Angular and C# .NET.
about.p2: I spent three years at DigiWall, a young SME in Belgium, where I contributed to six applications shipped to production — each for a different company. I built one of them entirely on my own, from analysis and design through development and release to production; it's still used every day across the company. I was also one of the lead developers for a US company based in Flanders — a full year working exclusively in English.
about.p3: I then wanted to take on a new environment, both geographical and professional: I moved to Québec. Despite a tough hiring climate, I managed to catch the eye of a supportive manager who gave me my chance. I'm now part of the large IT team at Beneva, where I build in Angular and TypeScript and ship to production on a regular basis. Although I joined recently, I've received positive feedback several times on my work and my progress.

now.heading: Now
now.lead: What I'm working on these days.
now.work: At Beneva, I build insurance features used directly by clients through their portal, with a new release shipped every three weeks.
now.building: I design and polish this portfolio, sweating the details on accessibility, performance and craft.
now.learning: I'm refining how I use AI in my day-to-day work, and aiming for a certification on the subject.
now.personal: Away from code, I'm learning the basics of Japanese and planning a trip to Japan.
